prompt: Create a screener for NIFTY 50 stocks that identifies the stock with the highest range (high minus low) from the first 5-minute candle each trading day. Show matches for multiple dates in one view, one row per stock per date, grouped by date. Use the last 10 trading sessions ending at the latest date with candles by default, with an inclusive from_date/to_date range filter for user selection and a maximum 90-calendar-day span. Evaluate each date independently and return only dates in the applied range. Display a Ranked Table with columns in this order: stock as Symbol (text), scan_date as Date (date), high as High (price), low as Low (price), range as range (text), and date as Candle time (datetime). Sort dates newest first and sort each date by range descending by default; allow sorting overrides. Include symbol search and click-to-sort controls. Show at most 1 stock per date, with Top N only pagination.
